gloss: to resist, to oppose, to defy

definitions.gloss: to resist, to oppose, to defy, to fight against
definitions.explanation: To stand against or refuse to submit to a force, authority, or fate. Often implies resistance to something overwhelming.

examples.japanese: {運命|うんめい}に{抗|あらが}う
{権力|けんりょく}に{抗|あらが}うのは{難|むずか}しい。
{老化|ろうか}に{抗|あらが}うことはできないが、{健康|けんこう}を{維持|いじ}することはできる。
examples.english: We cannot fight aging, but we can maintain our health.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). Takes に particle: ～に{抗|あらが}う.

CONJUGATION: Godan verb (wa-row): {抗|あらが}わない, {抗|あらが}います, {抗|あらが}って.

NUANCE: {抗|あらが}う implies fighting against something powerful or seemingly inevitable (fate, authority, natural forces). It has a literary or dramatic quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運命|うんめい}/{宿命|しゅくめい}に{抗|あらが}う (to defy fate/destiny)
- {権力|けんりょく}/{体制|たいせい}に{抗|あらが}う (to resist authority/the system)
- {老化|ろうか}/{時間|じかん}に{抗|あらが}う (to fight aging/time)
- {抗|あらが}えない (cannot resist/irresistible)

RELATED WORDS:
- {逆|さか}らう (to go against, oppose - more common)
- {抵抗|ていこう}する (to resist - more formal)
- {反抗|はんこう}する (to rebel - implies rebellion)
